title: Sounds
intro: Soft piano and gentle sounds, made right here on your device. Put one on to fall asleep, unwind, or slow your breathing down.

sleep.title: For sleep
sleep.body: Slow, low piano with soft rain. Set a timer and let it fade out on its own.

relax.title: To relax
relax.body: Light, unhurried piano with a warm hum underneath.

calm.title: When you feel anxious
calm.body: Slow waves that rise for four seconds and fall for six. Breathe in as they rise, out as they fall.

note: These are calming sounds, not a treatment. If you need support now, use SOS Support at the top of the screen.
